changes.reason: Must match the handling.meta handlingName so the vehicle loads its handling correctly.

vehicleTypeReason: vehicles.meta marks it as law enforcement with VC_EMERGENCY, FLAG_LAW_ENFORCEMENT, and a police driver plus police plate/siren metadata.

security.summary: No executable or network-capable behavior is present. The pack contains only vehicle assets and metadata, and the uploaded manifest is declarative-only. Any stale wildcard paths in the manifest are harmless because the importer regenerates the manifest from real files.

repairs.issue: Uses broad wildcard paths that may reference files not present in the archive.
repairs.action: Ignore the uploaded manifest and generate a fresh manifest from the actual .meta and asset files found.

remediation.summary: Quarantined the two runtime Lua scripts so only data-only vehicle assets and regenerated metadata remain for rescanning.

actions.reason: Runtime Lua script is not allowed in a data-only vehicle pack and can execute behavior outside the permitted asset set.
